Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this series then! KL Rahul is handed the trophy and he poses for the cameras along with his teammates. Now then, India have their next assignment in the Asia Cup. Their first match will be against Pakistan on 28th August at 7.30 pm IST ( 2.00 pm GMT)  while Zimbabwe will travel to Australia for a three-match ODI series. The first match will be on 28th August at 5.10 am IST ( 11.40 pm GMT, previous day). So, there is plenty of cricketing action across the globe to keep you busy. Keep checking the schedule page. From here, it is goodbye and cheers!

KL Rahul, the skipper of India is up for a chat. He says he feels great to win the series. Informs they wanted to use this time and use this opportunity and he’s really happy with the result. Mentions Sikandar Raza did take the game really deep, they would have loved to finish the game earlier on but it was a challenge for the bowlers and he’s happy they got across the line. Adds the body is fine and he is happy he could stay out there with the bat for longer.

Regis Chakabva, the captain of Zimbabwe is up for a chat. He starts by congratulating India but also credits Sikandar Raza for his knock. Mentions the boys fought really hard and he is happy with their effort. Mentions they’ll take a lot of positives from today and they’ll be looking to play some good cricket there.

Shubman Gill is the Player of the Series for his 245 runs in the three ODIs. He says it feels great to play with the same bunch and it is special. Mentions this one was for his dad, he has been his coach all his life.

Shubman Gill is the Player of the Match for his brilliant innings (130 runs off 97 balls). He says he was just trying to not play a lot of dots and just try to time the ball. Adds there were a couple of bowlers who were bowling well but once they got in, they took on the bowlers. Mentions he has a really good bat. Says the 100 is special, he did not have a 100 before and this is special.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier in the day, after electing to bat, India got to a total which we felt was above par coutesy a ton from Gill. Zimbabwe seemed down and out when they lost their 7th wicket and at that stage, it seemed like this would be defended easily. Raza though had different ideas, he gave India a real scare but the visitors got over the line.

India's bowling was brilliant till the 7th wicket. Their pacers were very good at the start and the spinners did brilliantly in the middle overs. Actually, the spinners were brilliant throughout. Combined they finished with figures of 20-1-68-4 but it seemed like the pacers would give it away. They took a real pounding towards the end. Especially Avesh Khan and Deepak Chahar. However, they did keep their calm and took their side over the line.

This innings though was just about one man, Sikandar Raza. It seemed all done when Zimbabwe were 169 for 7 but then came a special knock from Raza. He just wanted someone to hang in there and Evans did that. The two added over 100 with Raza scoring a ton and Evans doing what was needed of him. They needed just around 9 per over heading into the last 10 and they did manage to score at that rate. At one stage, they needed 17 from 13 and it seemed Zimbabwe would take this game but both Evans in Raza fell in quick succession and the last two could not do a lot. In the end, it was a hard fought win for India.

What a game! What an absolute beauty of a game that was! Sikandar Raza, what a player he has turned into, just magical. Have to feel sorry for him. Surely, this is one of the greatest knocks we have seen in a losing effort. Still though, Zimbabwe can be proud of the way they have competed. In the end though, it is India who complete the whitewash.

OUT! TIMBER! Avesh Khan bowls the perfect yorker to end things here. This is in the blockhole, on middle, Victor Nyauchi is very late to put his bat down to block it and the ball goes through and rattles the stumps. INDIA WIN BY 13 RUNS and wins the series 3-0.
A full toss and outside off, Richard Ngarava drills it towards sweeper cover for just one.
A dot to start the over! This is full and outside off, Richard Ngarava tries to heave it but misses. 15 needed in 5 now.
Another brilliant slower ball, on off and length again, Victor Nyauchi swings but cannot connect.
A slower ball, on a length and outsid off, Victor Nyauchi tries to cut it but misses.

OUT! TAKEN! A spectacular catch by Shubman Gill to send Raza back to the hut. That should be the game for India! Disbeleif amongst the Zimbabwe fans as their last hope is walking back. He though has played an absolute gem of an innings. An innings not many will forget Just stunning. Single-handedly, he has got Zimbabwe so close but he needed to be there till the end to take them over the line. Great gesture from the Indians as they come up to him and congratulate him for his knock. Coming to the ball now, it is full and on middle, Raza fails to get under it completely. He does not get the elevation he wanted. It goes flat towards long on. Gill dives forward and takes it.
Commentary.Howout: c Shubman Gill b Shardul Thakur

Commentary.Commentary: Another slower ball, on a length and on middle, Richard Ngarava goes for the heave but gets it of his gloves and the ball goes nowhere but Raza calls for the run, Thakur picks up and has a shy at the bowler' s end but misses and the batters get the run.
A slower length ball, outside off, Richard Ngarava has wild swing but misses.
Full and outside off, Sikandar Raza crunches it towards long off for a run.
Big moment in the game! Has this stand been broken? The umpire has raised his finger as there was an appeal for LBW. Evans reviews. It could be a good review.

OUT! LBW! A huge moment in the game. This is on a good length and on middle, angling in, Brad Evans moves across to work it to the le side but plays down the wrong line and gets hit on the pads. The fielders appeal for the LBW and the finger goes up. Evans takes the review straightaway. The UltraEdge shows no bat involved and Ball Tracking shows three reds and he has to go back. Finally India have broken this stand.

FOUR! A lucky boundary but Zimbabwe won't mind! This is overpitched and on off, Brad Evans slashes at it but gets an inside edge past the stumps and to the left of the keeper where Ishan Kishan also cannot stop it as it races away to the fine leg fence.
Another full delivery and on off, Sikandar Raza forces it towards long off for just a single. The partnership is now 100 runs between these two.

FOUR! Clever shot! This is full and outside off, Sikandar Raza shuffles across, gets on one knee and scoops it just over the short fine leg fielder for boundary.

2 runs.

Drinks! The spin duo of Kuldeep Yadav and Axar Patel have been excellent in the middle overs and they have put the pressure back on Zimbabwe. This is now a huge task for Zimbabwe to chase this one. But if they are to get close these two at the crease needs to take this game deep. India will look to take more wickets quickly. Let's see how it unfolds

This is short again and on leg, Sikandar Raza goes for the reverse sweep but misses and it goes towards the keeper. Ishan Kishan grabs it and dislodges the bails in a flash and appeals for the stumping. The umpires sends it upstairs. The UltraEdge shows that there is no bat involved and the replays shows that Raza's back foot is on the ground when the bails are off. However, the third umpire was pretty qucik to arrive at his decision as he did not watch the full replay. We can see that Raza lifted his back foot for a moment but it is very hard to see whether it was after both the bails were taken off or just one. Raza survives again. Can he make the most of it?

On middle, defended.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Tony Munyonga blocks it back to the bowler.
Floated, full and on middle, Sean Williams knocks it of his inner half towards mid-wicket for a run.

Drinks! After losing Innocent Kaia early on Zimbabwe have been steady. Tony Munyonga and Sean Williams have build up a good partnership and they are playing well. Takudzwanashe Kaitano had to retire hurt but that did not effect Zimbabwe much. These two on the crease will look to add more runs. India, on the other hand have bowlerd well but they need wickets. An exciting session awaits. Also, Deepak Hooda is into the attack now.
Nice delivery! This is on a good length and on off, holds its line, Tony Munyonga looks to poke at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Another short ball and outside off, Tony Munyonga goes for the cut but is a bit too late and misses it.
Bangs in a short ball, on middle, Sean Williams is through with his pull shot early and it goes of the top edge towards third man. They cross.
On a length and on middle, Sean Williams tucks it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! Thumped! Short and on middle, this is pulled through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On off, defended.
Dealing in singles at the moment! Shorter and outside off, Williams pushes it towards cover.
On off, this is pushed to covers.
Tony sweeps again, it is through square leg for another single.
Another sweep shot, this goes more off the underedge towards mid-wicket for one.
The sweep is out, it goes through square leg for one.
Tossed up on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On off, this is guided through point for one.
Shorter and on off, Williams pushes it to covers.
On off, blocked.
Shorter again, Tony pulls, not off the middle but it goes through square leg for one.
WIDE! Way too short. Wided.
Shorter and on the body, this is pulled down to fine leg for one.
Lands short! On middle, Williams looks to nudge it around the corner, this goes off a leading edge but lands well short of the bowler.
Lovely, lovely over! This lands on off and then spins away. Tony is yet again beaten as he tries to defend.
Now the one that comes back! A little too short. Tony goes back but fails to put bat on ball and gets hit on the pad.
Another beauty! Tony is not picking Kuldeep! The googly again, it lands on off and spins away. Tony is beaten as he tries to block.
That is a beauty! This is tossed up on off, it lands and spins away. Tony Munyonga looks to defend but is beaten. He does well not to push at it.
On middle, this is worked through square leg for one.
WIDE! That was so close to the leg pole! Down the leg side. Williams gets right across and looks to sweep but misses. Wided in the end.
The sweep is out, it is played through square leg for one. Fifty up for Zimbabwe.
Powerplay 2! The fielding side can now have up to 4 players outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Also, Kuldeep Yadav comes into the attack now.
Around off, Tony Munyonga guides it to point.
On middle, defended.
Uppish but safe! Shorter and on middle, Williams looks to pull, this goes off the splice towards square leg for one.
Angled into middle, Williams defends.
Shortish, this is pushed to covers.
On off, blocked.
Shardul Thakur comes into the attack now.
Outside off, left alone.
A single as this is worked through mid-wicket.
FOUR! That has been nailed! A short one again and Williams picks it, he smashes it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Good length and on off, Sean pushes it to covers.
Goes short again and around off, Williams looks to pull but it goes off the underedge towards mid-wicket.
That stays low! Shorter and outside off, Williams looks to pull but this one does not bounce a lot. Beaten.
Another one on a length and around middle, blocked.
Good length and on off, Tony Munyonga pushes it to covers.
Shorter and on middle, Tony Munyonga pulls but to mid on.
Another one on a length and around off, this is pushed to mid off.
Outside off, shaping away. Left alone.
On off, this is pushed to mid off.
Gets this one to shape back in. Tony Munyonga looks to drive but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket for one.
Just outside off, left alone.
Lovely delivery! Length and on off, this one shapes away. Tony Munyonga is beaten as he tries to block.
Outside off, left alone.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
FOUR! Slapped hard! Shorter and outside off, this is slapped through covers for a boundary.
It does not look good for Takudzwanashe Kaitano as he is now walking back to the hut. This is not good news for Zimbabwe. Tony Munyonga comes out to bat now.

SIX! Top edge and it goes all the way! The last ball spoils the over. Zimbabwe won't mind how they come as long as they do. Short and on middle, Takudzwanashe Kaitano looks to pull, it goes off the top edge, over the keeper and towards the fine leg fence.
A single as this is guided down to third man.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Outside off, left alone.
Takudzwanashe Kaitano looks in some discomfort and is stretching his legs. The physios are in to check on him. Everything seems fine now and we are ready to continue.

That is a nasty delivery! Short and on middle, this one takes off. Takudzwanashe Kaitano looks to defend, it goes off the glove and down to third man. He somehow gets to the other end, limping. He now needs treatment.
Goes fuller again and on middle, Kaitano pushes it to mid off.
WIDE! This is short and well wide outside off, left alone.
FOUR! A boundary to end and Zimbabwe have had back-to-back productive overs! Fuller and outside off, Williams hits it down the ground, past long on and into the fence.
Williams misses out! This is short again and on middle, Williams pulls but straight to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Thumped down the ground! Shorter and around off, Williams drags it wide of mid on and this one races away to the fence. Runs coming thick and fast now.
Length and around off, Kaitano looks to defend but the outswing means it takes the outside edge, goes down to third man for one.
Fuller and outside off, Williams goes after it, it goes off the outside edge down to third man for one.
Lovely shot but to the fielder! Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
A dot to end the over! This is on a good length and on off, Takudzwanashe Kaitano guides it towards point. 9 runs from the over.

FOUR! Takudzwanashe Kaitano finally gets off the mark with a fine boundary. This is overpitched and on middle, Takudzwanashe Kaitano drives it firmly past the bowler and towards the long on fence for four runs.
Fullish one, on off, swinging away, Takudzwanashe Kaitano pushes it towards covers.
Full again and on off, Sean Williams drills it through covers for one.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is a bit fuller, on middle, Sean Williams stays there and flicks it uppishly over the mid on fielder for a boundary.
A yorker, swinging in, on leg, Sean Williams tries to dig it out but misses and gets hit on the pads. Avesh Khan appeals for the LBW but the finger stays down.
Another delivery that is shaping away, on off, Takudzwanashe Kaitano leaves it alone.
Full again and on off, shaping away, Takudzwanashe Kaitano blocks it to the leg side with his inner half.
Full and on off, Sean Williams drives it through mid off for a single and gets off the mark.
Sean Williams walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! LBW! Deepak Chahar provides the breakthrough for India as he always does. He bowls a brilliant inswinging yorker, on middle, Innocent Kaia tries to dig it out but is late to put his bat down in time and gets on the pads in line with the stumps. There is a huge shout for the LBW but turned down. KL Rahul goes for the review after some discussion. The UltraEdge shows that it is pad first and Ball Tracking shows three reds. The on-field decision is changed to Out. Kaia has to go back but he is not happy as he thinks he has hit the ball. India with an early wicket here.
A review for LBW by India. The UltraEdge shows that it is pad first so we move onto Ball Tracking. We have three reds and the on-field decision is changed to Out.
FOUR! Kaia tries to break the shackles now. This is on a good length and on off, Innocent Kaia skips down the track and heaves it wide of the mid on fielder for the first boundary of this innings.
This is overpitched and on off, Innocent Kaia drives it firmly but straight to the cover fielder.
Avesh Khan with tight line on the stumps, fuller, Takudzwanashe Kaitano blocks it down the pitch.
Full again and outside off, Innocent Kaia drills it past point for one.
Goes full this time, on off, Innocent Kaia knocks it towards covers.
BEAUTY! This is again on a good length and around off, Innocent Kaia leans on to block it but gets beaten all ends up.
Full and on middle, Innocent Kaia blocks it out.
Starts with a good-length delievry and outside off, shaping away, Innocent Kaia slashes but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Avesh Khan to share the attack with Deepak Chahar.
Length ball, on off, Takudzwanashe Kaitano tries to cut it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Full and on off, Innocent Kaia drives it towards covers for a single and gets off the mark.

Overthrows and Zimbabwe are underway! This is on a good lengh and on middle, angling in, Takudzwanashe Kaitano misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. There is an appeal for LBW but turned down. The ball rolls towards point and he hits the stumps at the striker's end and it goes away towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Goes fuller this time, on off, shaping away again, Takudzwanashe Kaitano offers no shot at it.
Another outswinger, on a good length and around off, Takudzwanashe Kaitano leaves it alone.
Deepak Chahar starts with a full delivery, swinging away, Takudzwanashe Kaitano blocks it to the left of the bowler.
